PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
PMO and Automation professional with approximately 6 years of experience across project governance, stakeholder management, project tracking, reporting, data analytics, and process automation. Experienced in RAID management, milestone and dependency tracking, governance cadence, financial PMO, and management reporting across global teams. Strong technical expertise in Excel VBA, SQL, Power Query, Power BI, and Microsoft Office, with a proven track record of developing 20+ financial and operational automation solutions. Combines PMO, analytical, and automation capabilities to improve project visibility, reporting efficiency, and operational performance.

CORE SKILLS
PMO & Program Management | Project Governance | Global Compliance Management | Client & Stakeholder Management | Financial PMO & Forecasting | Plan vs Actuals | Profitability & WIP Tracking | Billing & Invoicing | PO Reconciliation | RAID / Risk & Issue Management | Scope & Dependency Management | Power BI & Data Analytics | Management Reporting | VBA Automation | Change Management
TECHNICAL SKILLS
PMO & Project Management: Project Governance, Project Tracking, Agile & Scrum, Sprint Planning, Sprint Cadence, RAID Management, Risk & Issue Management, Milestone Tracking, Dependency Management, Status Reporting, Stakeholder Management, Change Management

Microsoft Office: Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, Microsoft Office Suite

Mentoring | Root-Cause Analysis | Process Improvement
Sarvagya | PMO Sr. Analyst – Automation, Reporting & Data Analytics
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Deloitte USI | Hyderabad Research Sr. Analyst – PMO, Automation & Reporting, VBA | September 2022 – January 2026
Managed PMO activities for Deloitte Global Tax and Legal office of Hyderabad, supporting business setup, project governance, stakeholder coordination, reporting, and operational execution across global teams.
Managed commercial PMO activities including distributed/centralized billing, invoicing issue management, and reconciliation of invoices against Purchase Orders (POs).
Supported engagement financial management through creation, validation, and analysis of dashboards covering Plan vs Actuals, financial forecasts, profitability, and Work-in-Progress (WIP).
Coordinated with client stakeholders, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and geographically distributed Member Firm teams to drive deliverables, dependencies, action items, and engagement priorities.
Maintained project documentation and PMO tools, ensuring governance artifacts, reporting inputs, action trackers, and engagement information remain accurate and up to date.
Served as a Sprint Delegate and partnered with Directors and Business Partners on high-priority initiatives, supporting PMO governance, milestone tracking, RAID management, and stakeholder follow-up.
Supported change management initiatives across multiple locations by developing and implementing 24 Excel/VBA- based financial and operational tools using VBA, Macros, Power Query, and advanced Excel to automate reporting and streamline business processes.
Automated recurring management and stakeholder reporting, including weekly meeting-alignment and monthly KPI reporting, improving reporting consistency and reducing manual effort.
Deputized for Assistant Managers in managing multiple Member Firms globally and conducted root-cause analysis for risks, followed by corrective-action tracking along with facilitating and managing end to end scrum calls. • Coordinated compliance-related governance activities across global teams, maintaining trackers, monitoring adherence to required processes, and following up with stakeholders on pending actions and exceptions.
Created process documentation and SOPs and trained and mentored new hires across projects. • Managed risks and issues across multiple initiatives and maintained governance documentation to provide leadership with clear visibility of project health.
Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) Assistant System Engineer – Automation & Reporting | May 2021 – September 2022
Developed VBA-based automation solutions for recurring business and reporting activities, improving operational efficiency and reducing manual effort.
Gathered requirements and collaborated with stakeholders to design and implement 5+ high-value MS Office automation projects.
Supported project reporting and delivery tracking by coordinating with stakeholders on task status, timelines, action items, and reporting requirements.
Built an Outlook email automation solution using VBA to batch-send emails with attachments, standardized subject

lines, and configurable CC/BCC rules, with recipient information sourced from SQL. Improved stakeholder communication and achieved approximately 99% on-time delivery while saving approximately 12 hours per month in manual effort.
Developed customizable PowerPoint templates and Microsoft Office automation solutions to standardize recurring reporting and presentation activities.
Used SQL and Excel-based data processing to support reporting, automation, and operational decision-making.
Sarvagya | PMO Sr. Analyst – Automation, Reporting & Data Analytics
Map My India Software Trainee – Data Analysis & Reporting | September 2019 – October 2020
Developed Excel-based reporting solutions for aggregation, consolidation, and comparative analysis of large datasets.
Created advanced Excel formulas to calculate labor rates, aggregate costs, and support operational analysis. • Analyzed installation documents and system log files to identify recurring issues and document standardized solutions.
Supported data validation, reporting, and process improvement activities through structured analysis of operational information.
SELECTED PROJECTS & INITIATIVES

Innovation Quest – Deloitte | Outlook PII Exfiltration Prevention: Contributed to an innovation initiative focused on preventing unauthorized transmission of personally identifiable information through Outlook.
Macro-Based Tool Generator – TCS: Developed a reusable macro-based tool generator to automate repetitive tasks, resulting in approximately 20%-time savings.
